params.name: namespace

params.name: subject_name

tools.name: purchase_node_reserved_instances
tools.description: Buys an EC2 Reserved Instance offering for the cluster's worker node instance type, charging the AWS account for the reservation term.

params.name: offering_id
params.description: ID of the Reserved Instances offering to buy.

params.name: instance_count
params.description: Number of reserved instances to purchase.

params.name: max_hourly_price
params.description: Maximum acceptable hourly price per instance in USD.

tools.code:
import boto3
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def purchase_node_reserved_instances(offering_id: str, instance_count: int, max_hourly_price: float) -> dict:
    ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
    r = ec2.purchase_reserved_instances_offering(
        ReservedInstancesOfferingId=offering_id,
        InstanceCount=instance_count,
        LimitPrice={"Amount": max_hourly_price, "CurrencyCode": "USD"},
    )
    rid = r["ReservedInstancesId"]
    d = ec2.describe_reserved_instances(ReservedInstancesIds=[rid])["ReservedInstances"][0]
    return {
        "reserved_instances_id": rid,
        "instance_type": d.get("InstanceType"),
        "count": d.get("InstanceCount"),
        "state": d.get("State"),
        "fixed_price": d.get("FixedPrice"),
    }

tools.name: drain_and_remove_node
tools.description: Runs kubectl to cordon and drain a node, evicting its pods (emptyDir data on the node is lost), then deletes the Node object from the cluster.

params.name: node_name
params.description: Name of the node to drain and remove.

params.name: grace_period_seconds
params.description: Grace period given to each evicted pod; defaults to 60.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Overall timeout for the drain; defaults to 600.
